actions.label: Jail the player
actions.desc: Drops a solid cage around the streamer right where they stand. They can see the money through the bars and walk into them, but their tools stop working and they earn nothing until the time is up. More jail gifts add more time.

actions.label: Free the player from jail
actions.desc: Lets the streamer out of jail early. The cage disappears and they carry on where they are.

actions.label: Add money
actions.desc: Pays the streamer this many dollars straight into their balance.

actions.label: Remove money
actions.desc: Takes this many dollars out of the streamer's balance. It stops at zero.

actions.label: Money multiplier
actions.desc: Multiplies everything the streamer earns for a while. 2 doubles it, 0.05 leaves them with almost nothing.

actions.label: Launch the player
actions.desc: Throws the streamer into the air using the game's own launch effect. Needs the game's stream mode running.

actions.label: Remove bills
actions.desc: Takes bills from the main pile (wherever you are) and pays you for them at your shredder rate, as if you shredded them yourself. They count toward the billion.

actions.label: Add bills
actions.desc: Dumps this many extra bills onto the pile, so the streamer has more to clear. Set any amount.

actions.label: Insta win
actions.desc: Clears every bill left in the pile and plays the game's ending, like a won run.

actions.label: Insta reset
actions.desc: Instantly wipes the progress back to a brand-new game: money and the pile. The old save is backed up first, just in case.

actions.label: Reset timer
actions.desc: Puts a countdown box in the middle of the screen with your save gift. If nobody sends the save gift before it hits 0, the save is wiped back to a brand-new game (a backup is still made first). Make a separate trigger with "Save from reset" for the gift that saves you.

actions.label: Save from reset
actions.desc: Stops a running reset timer, so the current save is kept. Put this on the gift that should save you; that gift picture shows in the countdown box.
